scope: Research-only, sourced evidence; not a sealed article, complete media slate or PUBLIC_CLOSED.

source_evidence.read_scope: Full changelog: default agent model governance, inline diagnostic fixes, MCP startup control, UX/reliability changes and JetBrains deprecation
supported_facts: Managed enterprise settings choose default agent model for new JetBrains sessions while user still has model picker.
Fix diagnostic action opens inline chat and uses agent mode where possible.
New setting can disable automatic MCP server startup for Copilot and Claude.
Plugin requires JetBrains IDE 2025.2 or later.

source_evidence.read_scope: Complete primary publisher article, score table, footnotes and limitations
supported_facts: Ironclad and OpenAI researchers defined 11 contracting tasks with 8–50 success criteria each.
On those research tasks Astra averaged 55.0% vs GPT-5.6 Sol 41.6%; estimated time per attempt 19.2 vs 37.0 minutes.
The time figures are estimates from simulated task runs, not measured customer productivity.
No customer confidential contracts were used to train/evaluate per OpenAI description.

source_evidence.read_scope: Complete SAP Connect feature from Joule conversations/spaces/Studio and platform/business graph through security, governance and measurement sections
supported_facts: SAP describes three Joule Work pillars: conversations, spaces, Joule Studio.
SAP says agents run under deterministic application rules, scoped access and audit trail.
Three human oversight levels described: approval, monitoring and override.
Customer productivity and graph coverage numbers in article are SAP-reported claims, not independent benchmarking.

source_evidence.read_scope: Complete short survey article including population, license table, methodology caveat, frontmatter example and FAQs
supported_facts: SkillMD reports 901,653 of 1,081,266 public indexed SKILL.md files lack license frontmatter, 83.4%.
Measurement checks frontmatter only and intentionally excludes repository-level license files.
The source recommends SPDX identifier and linting for externally redistributed skills.
limitations: Registry is self-reported sampling; not all Agent Skills everywhere.
No license frontmatter does not necessarily imply no repository-level license.
